title: Introducing Text to Trade
summary: Describe an idea and Astor helps you build and size a strategy. You approve every trade, and it executes in your own Robinhood agentic account.
body_markdown:
## Why does every trade wait for your yes?


Because we don’t make decisions for anyone. Robinhood lets agents be set up to trade without asking each time, and we chose not to build Astor that way. Astor does the research and proposes the trades, and nothing is bought until you approve each one. In your other connected accounts, at Robinhood or anywhere else, Astor can see your holdings but can’t trade or move money.


Astor is an SEC-registered investment adviser and owes its clients a fiduciary duty. The AI is the tool we use to do the work, and it can be wrong, so keeping you in the loop on every trade is the honest way to use it.
